//: The AML case team. Three controls a prompt cannot hold: no tipping off, four eyes on the actions that hurt a customer, and no approver with a stake in the subject.

Tipping off is checked on the recipient of an outbound message, in Gmail or Slack, whoever sends it: anyone within two hops of the subject of an open case (their relationship manager, a fellow director) is off limits. 31 U.S.C. 5318(g)(2) makes disclosing a SAR to the subject unlawful; the bank's rule is wider, on purpose.

A freeze or a SAR always needs a second person. That person must be a BSA officer, must not own the case, and must have no path to the subject within three hops: the graph is the conflict-of-interest register.
PII is masked for everyone: the model never needs an SSN or a full account number to investigate, and the SAR record links to the subject in the graph, not to digits a model copied.

TODO(module 03): three pre rules. No Gmail.SendEmail or Slack.SendDmToUser to anyone within 2 hops of an open case's subject (recipient_near_case_subject). On Decide for freeze_account or file_sar: never the case owner (caller_owns_case), and never anyone with a path to the subject within 3 hops (caller_linked_to_subject).

rules.description: Only the AML team sees the case tools.
rules.reason: Case tools are for the AML team.

rules.description: A freeze always needs a second person's approval.
rules.reason: DENIED: freezing {{account_id}} needs a second person's sign-off. Call Bank_RequestApproval with action=freeze_account, resource_id={{account_id}}, case_id={{case_id}} and justification=<the evidence>, then stop. Once a BSA officer approves, retry Bank_FreezeAccount with the same arguments once.

rules.description: Filing a SAR always needs a second person's approval.
rules.reason: DENIED: filing a SAR on {{case_id}} needs a second person's sign-off. Call Bank_RequestApproval with action=file_sar, resource_id={{case_id}} and justification=<the narrative in brief>, then stop. Once a BSA officer approves, retry Bank_FileSar with the same arguments once.

rules.description: Only a BSA officer decides a freeze or a SAR.
rules.reason: DENIED: {{request_id}} is a {{request_action}} request, which only a BSA officer decides.

rules.description: Masks SSNs, dates of birth and full account numbers on every Bank tool, for everyone, before a model reads them.
rules.reason: Personal identifiers masked before the output reached the model.
